The variant name(s) to output, can be used multiple times to specify multiple variants. When specifying multiple variants, use ${VARIANT} in the output path to generate separate files for each variant. When no --variant argument is provided, the default variant is output.
Use a named BOM preset setting from this editor, e.g. "Grouped By Value".
Use a named BOM format preset setting from this editor, e.g. CSV.
An ordered list of fields to export. Generated fields such as QUANTITY, ITEM_NUMBER, DNP, EXCLUDE_FROM_BOM, EXCLUDE_FROM_BOARD, and EXCLUDE_FROM_SIM can be specified with or without ${} delimiters.
An ordered list of labels to apply the exported fields.
Fields to group references by when field values match.
Field name to sort by.
Sort ascending (true) or descending (false).
Filter string to remove output lines.
Fields to search when filtering: reference, visible, or all.
Exclude components marked Do-Not-Populate.
Deprecated. Has no effect.
Separator between output fields/columns.
Character to surround fields with.
Character to place between individual references.
Character to place in ranges of references. Leave blank for no ranges.
Keep tab characters from input fields. Stripped by default.
Keep line break characters from input fields. Stripped by default.
Include a UTF-8 byte order mark at the start of the exported file.
